digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping CI job and environment contract
propositions: On-demand CI job must answer a fixed checklist of questions about the Jira DC image (templates, issue types, fields, workflows, statuses, priorities, link types, field length limits) and emit structured evidence with raw request/response pairs, not LLM-summarized prose.
The mapping job's output (declared environment contract) must be committed as data and consumed by harness setup assertions at test time, with zero re-derivation or discovery during test execution.
The image digest must be derived from the Dockerfile FROM line and asserted in committed data, preventing the map from going stale after a re-pin with nothing detecting it.
Link-type direction verification requires end-to-end experiments (create issues, write links, read back both sides) to detect inverted direction, which name-only checks cannot catch.

Field length limits (summary, label, description, comment) must be measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with read-back comparison to detect silent truncation, and the instance property jira.text.field.character.limit must be read rather than hardcoded.
The mapping job is workflow_dispatch-only with no push/PR/schedule triggers and read-only MCP mode, asserted by tests rather than assumed from YAML configuration.
